rule_sources.description: Personally viewed PDF p12 #77, US3 Mid starred: US may discard up to entire hand including scoring; replacement count decided before any draw.
PDFp4 sections4.3/4.3.1/4.4: consume old deck, empty deck reshuffles all discards, era insertion at era transition only; p5 5.2/5.4 discard without event; section9 China separate.
PDFp15 #77: choosing replacements creates no held-scoring exemption. p16 #98 intro excludes pre-Remix sequencing questions; old Ames order is not adopted.

Zero selection is successful no-change event. Freshly discarded selected cards join all discards and may be redrawn. Positive draw exactly exhausting old deck reshuffles eligible current discards before source/parent cleanup, without extra draw, from R2015 4.3/4.3.1; not specialist FAQ. Locked selection and bound permutation receipts are engineering; real shuffle/RNG, authentication and durable storage remain planned.
